t: 3450 – Maximum Students on a Single Bench
o: Group student IDs by bench ID (deduplicating repeats), and report the largest group size; empty input yields 0. Example 1: bench 3 collects {1,2,3} → 3. Constraints are tiny (≤100 entries), so hashing is more than enough.
k: Deduplicate (bench, student) pairs with a set per bench.
Answer is the max set size, defaulting to 0.

a.i: Map each bench to a set of student IDs; sets automatically deduplicate repeated entries.

w: Watch the empty-input edge case (max of empty collection). Trivial follow-ups: benches sorted output, or counting distinct benches.
